theorems.statement: ∀ (n ℓ : ℕ) (A : (Rn n →L[ℝ] Rn ℓ) →L[ℝ] (Rn n →L[ℝ] Rn ℓ) →L[ℝ] ℝ) (V : Rn n → Rn ℓ) (v : Rn n), ContDiff ℝ 2 V → (∀ ζ : Rn n → Rn ℓ, ContDiff ℝ 1 ζ → HasCompactSupport ζ → ∫ x, A (fderiv ℝ V x) (fderiv ℝ ζ x) = 0) → ∀ ζ : Rn n → Rn ℓ, ContDiff ℝ 1 ζ → HasCompactSupport ζ → ∫ x, A (fderiv ℝ (fun y => fderiv ℝ V y v) x) (fderiv ℝ ζ x) = 0
